label: Uniform positive numerical gap
definition: The single supplied real epsilon satisfies 0 < epsilon. It is fixed for all edges, not a node-dependent positive quantity. epsilon=1 satisfies it; epsilon=0 does not. This is pure arithmetic, not a grounding claim.
